hero.heading: Orienteering fixtures across Cornwall.
hero.lede: Our fixtures take place throughout the year and vary in format - from woodland and moorland events to summer urban races and coastal courses. Whatever your experience, there's a course to suit you, and newcomers are always welcome.

neighbours.intro:
Upcoming events run by the other orienteering clubs in the South West Orienteering Association (SWOA): Devon, Wimborne, Wessex, Quantock, Bristol (BOK), North Gloucestershire, North Wilts and Sarum. KERNO members and non-members are welcome to enter; most events accept pre-entry through the usual sign-up sites such as SI Entries, Racesignup and Fabian4. 
For a national overview see British Orienteering's full event listing →](https://www.britishorienteering.org.uk/event).
